title: Security fix for GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w applied in: miniforge3 25.11.0.1-r6, miniforge3 26.1.1.3-r4
description: A security vulnerability was identified in the miniforge3 package and has been addressed in versions 25.11.0.1-r6 and 26.1.1.3-r4. The vulnerability has a low severity rating with a CVSS score of 1. The issue requires local access with high attack complexity and partial privileges, and user interaction is needed for exploitation. No known exploits are reported in the wild.
